content.text:
This vendor-specific log page, C3h shall be 512 bytes with the following functional requirements and
field format (see Appendix C Latency Monitoring Feature Set Theory of Operation for additional
details):

tables.title: Table_4_8_9_Latency_Monitor_Log_Identifier_C3h
tables.table_md:
| Requirement ID | Byte Address | Field | # of Bytes | Field Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | LMDATA-1 | 0 | Latency Monitor Feature Status | 1 | 7:3 Reserved. Shall be cleared to zero.
2:0 Active Measured Latency Supported.
When set to 1b the Active Measured Latency field is supported and shall be implemented in the Active Latency Configuration settings. When cleared to 0b the Active Measured Latency is not supported.
1 Active Latency Configuration/Active Latency Mode 1 Supported.
When set to 1b the device shall support the Active Latency Configuration with the Active Latency Mode = 1b. When cleared to 0b the device does not support Active Latency Mode 1b.
0 Latency Monitoring Feature Enabled
This is a global feature enable.
When set to 1b the latency monitoring feature for this device is enabled. When cleared to 0b all features in the latency Monitoring Log page are disabled for this device and can be ignored. When cleared to 0b the other fields in this log page are not power loss safe and may be corrupted. | | LMDATA-2 | 1 | Reserved | 1 | The default value shall be 07h. | | Requirement ID | Byte Address | Field | # of Bytes | Field Description | | LMDATA-3 | 32 | Active Bucket Timer | 2 | The Active Bucket Timer is in 5-millisecond increments. Thus, a value of 0000h is 5 minutes. The Active Bucket Timer is used to count the number of times the Active Bucket Timer has been accumulating data. The Active Bucket Timer will saturate and there is a power cycle the Active Bucket Timer reaches the Active Bucket Timer Threshold then the device specified in Appendix C – Latency Monitoring Register Set Theory of Operation is moved into the Active Bucket. The Active Bucket Timer is cleared to 0000h and restarts counting. If the Active Bucket Timer will saturate, and the power cycle the Active Bucket Timer value from the Active Bucket Timer and the Active Bucket Timer shall continue when the device is powered. The factory default value of the Active Bucket Timer Threshold shall be set to 07D0h. | | LMDATA-4 | 5:4 | Active Threshold A | 2 | When the Active Latency Stamp is the threshold used to compare with the Active Bucket Timer, When cleared to 0000h this threshold is not used, the Active Bucket Timer will saturate, and the Static Latency Stamp will not be loaded. This threshold is in 5-minute increments. The factory default value shall be 07D0h. | | LMDATA-5 | 6 | Active Threshold B | 1 | This defines Active Bucket A. This is in 5ms increments. The factory default is 13h. | | LMDATA-6 | 7 | Active Threshold C | 1 | This is in 5ms increments. The factory default is 13h. | | LMDATA-7 | 8 | Active Threshold D | 1 | This is in 5ms increments. The factory default is 20h. | | LMDATA-8 | 9 | Active Threshold E | 1 | This is in 5ms increments. The factory default is 20h. | | LMDATA-9 | 11:10 | Active Threshold F | 2 | This configures both the Active Latency Stamp, and the Active Measured Latency Fields. The default value shall be 07D0h. | | Requirement ID | Byte Address | Field | # of Bytes | Field Description | | LMDATA-10 | 12 | Active Latency Window | 1 | The default value shall be 0FFh. | | LMDATA-11 | 13 | Reserved | 1 | This field contains the minimum number of 100-millisecond increments between Latency Events for a single Active Latency Stamp and the Active Measured Latency. When cleared to zero, this field is disabled. This count is to 100 milliseconds increments, thus a value of 03h is 100 milliseconds and 02h is 200 milliseconds. Once a latency Stamp/Measured Latency is updated the Active Latency Minimum Window time has not expired and an event is configured to generate a latency Stamp/Measured latency the Latency Stamp/Measured Latency will not be recorded. The default value of this field is 0Ah. | | LMDATA-12 | 47:32 | Active Bucket Counter 0 | 16 | 15:12 N/A N/A Reserved. Shall be cleared to zero.
